item.title: Breakdown: How the Chicago Bears can create more than $50 million in cap space this offseason
item.description: The Chicago Bears will need to make some tough decisions this offseason to get under the salary cap, as they are currently $5.3 million over the limit, with potential cuts and contract restructures to save up to $55 million.

item.title: Chicago's food delivery robots: How they work and what's next
item.description: Coco and Serve Robotics have been operating food delivery robots in Chicago since late 2024, with 83% of residents in the 1st Ward opposing further expansion of the program due to concerns about speed and accessibility.
